dedupe_keys.name: estonia wastewater treatment plants effluent outlets and wastewater collection areas inspire eelis

description: This INSPIRE utility and government services dataset maps Estonia's wastewater infrastructure as held in the Estonian nature information system (EELIS). Contents: wastewater treatment plants and effluent outlets as point facilities, 1,009 features on 29 September 2026, and wastewater collection areas (agglomerations) as polygons, 546 features, with identifiers and names that link to environmental permits and reporting. Producer: the environmental administration that manages EELIS (Keskkonnaagentuur), with the web services run by Maa- ja Ruumiamet. Coverage: all of Estonia, published since 2020. Format and access: INSPIRE WFS and WMS on the national geoportal with metadata in the national catalogue; the open data portal lists the WFS under CC0. Free. Caveats: the layers show plant and outlet locations and collection areas, not sewer pipes or treatment capacity in detail; for capacity and load figures, the EU Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive reporting is the usual complement. Update frequency is irregular. Simulation uses: locating treatment plants and outlets for flood exposure and pollution-on-failure scenarios, and defining service areas for water sector interdependency models. Related records: the Estonian Topographic Database (data-estonia-etak-topographic-database) and the building register (data-estonia-ehitisregister-building-register).
